title: Cilium Certified Associate (CCA) Practice Exam — 120 Questions
description: Unofficial CCA practice exam with 120 English multiple-choice questions and bilingual explanations. The topic distribution follows the official CCA exam-domain weights and includes manifests, annotations, CLI commands and flags, protocol ports, troubleshooting scenarios, and implementation details.

questions.question:
A Cilium-managed node continues forwarding existing pod traffic, but newly scheduled pods on that node cannot
obtain networking. Which component on the node is directly responsible for loading endpoint eBPF programs and
programming the local datapath?

choices.text: The Cilium agent running as part of the Cilium DaemonSet on that node.
Hubble Relay, because it distributes flow state and endpoint routes to all nodes.
The Kubernetes scheduler, because it attaches Cilium programs after binding a pod.
The Cilium operator Deployment, because it programs every node's eBPF maps directly.

explanation.en:
The Cilium agent runs on each node and manages the node-local datapath, including endpoint configuration,
eBPF programs, service load balancing, policy enforcement, and visibility.
explanation.ja:
Cilium Agentは各Nodeで動作し、そのNodeのEndpoint設定、eBPFプログラム、Service Load Balancing、
NetworkPolicy、可観測性などのローカルDatapathを管理します。

questions.question:
The Cilium operator is unavailable for several minutes, while all Cilium agents remain healthy. Which impact is
most likely to appear first in a cluster using cluster-pool IPAM?

choices.text: New node PodCIDR allocation may be delayed, while established datapath forwarding can continue.
Existing pod-to-pod packets stop because the operator is in the forwarding path.
Kubernetes Services immediately lose all eBPF load-balancing entries on every node.
Every Hubble flow is lost because the operator stores the per-node ring buffers.

explanation.en:
The operator performs cluster-wide control-plane duties such as cluster-pool IPAM allocation, but it is not in
the packet-forwarding or policy-enforcement critical path. Existing programmed datapaths can therefore continue.
explanation.ja:
Operatorはcluster-pool IPAMなどのクラスタ全体の制御を担当しますが、通常のPacket Forwardingの
クリティカルパスにはいません。そのため既存通信は継続できても、新NodeへのPodCIDR割り当ては遅れ得ます。

questions.question:
When Kubernetes creates a pod sandbox on a Cilium node, which component is invoked by the container runtime to
connect the pod network namespace and then communicates with the local Cilium agent?

choices.text: The Cilium CNI plugin.
The clustermesh-apiserver.
The Cilium operator.
The Hubble CLI binary.

explanation.en:
The container runtime invokes the Cilium CNI plugin during pod network setup and teardown. The plugin coordinates
with the local Cilium agent to create the endpoint and configure connectivity.
explanation.ja:
PodのNetwork Namespaceを接続するとき、Container RuntimeがCilium CNI Pluginを呼び出します。
CNI PluginはローカルのCilium Agentと連携してEndpointとネットワークを設定します。

questions.question:
An engineer runs a Hubble client against one Cilium agent's local Unix socket and sees only flows observed on that
node. Which architectural fact explains this behavior?

choices.text: Hubble UI suppresses remote-node flows until Prometheus is enabled.
The Cilium operator shards Hubble data by namespace rather than by node.
A Hubble Server is embedded in each Cilium agent and exposes that node's observations.
Hubble Relay stores only local-node flows unless a Service is marked global.

explanation.en:
Each Cilium agent contains a Hubble Server. Its local API exposes flows observed by that node; cluster-wide access
normally goes through Hubble Relay.
explanation.ja:
Hubble Serverは各Cilium Agent内にあり、そのNodeで観測したFlowを公開します。クラスタ全体のFlowを
まとめて参照する場合は通常Hubble Relayを利用します。

questions.question:
A platform team wants one Hubble API endpoint that aggregates flows from every Cilium node without copying the
datapath into a central proxy. Which component should clients query?

choices.text: Cilium Operator, which periodically exports all BPF maps as flow records.
Hubble Relay, which discovers and connects to the per-node Hubble Servers.
CoreDNS, which merges node-local Hubble sockets through service discovery.
Cilium CNI, which aggregates flows whenever a pod is created or deleted.

explanation.en:
Hubble Relay provides a cluster-wide API by discovering the Hubble Servers embedded in Cilium agents and
aggregating their flow streams.
explanation.ja:
Hubble Relayは各NodeのCilium Agent内にあるHubble Serverを発見して接続し、クラスタ全体のFlowを
1つのAPIとして集約します。

questions.question: You need to inspect the BPF load-balancer map on one specific node. Which tool choice is most appropriate?

choices.text: Use only the workstation-level `cilium` CLI because it reads every node-local BPF map directly.
Query the Cilium operator metrics endpoint because all datapath maps are mirrored there.
Run `hubble observe --protocol bpf` through Relay to print the map contents.
Execute `cilium-dbg bpf lb list` in the Cilium agent pod on the target node.

explanation.en:
The cluster-level `cilium` CLI manages and inspects the deployment, while `cilium-dbg` is the node-local
diagnostic tool that can inspect the local agent and BPF maps.
explanation.ja:
Workstationから使う`cilium` CLIはクラスタレベルの管理用です。特定NodeのBPF Mapを調べる場合は、
対象NodeのCilium Agent Pod内で`cilium-dbg`を実行します。

questions.question:
A pod is recreated with a different IP address but exactly the same security-relevant labels. Under Cilium's
identity model, what is the expected policy behavior?

choices.text: It receives the reserved `world` identity because its previous IP no longer exists.
It can receive the same numeric security identity and retain equivalent label-based policy treatment.
The pod bypasses policy until kube-proxy creates a replacement identity rule.
All policy access is lost because every IP address permanently defines a unique identity.

explanation.en:
Cilium derives security identities from security-relevant labels rather than tying policy directly to a pod IP.
A recreated pod with the same label set can therefore receive the same identity and policy treatment.
explanation.ja:
CiliumのSecurity IdentityはPod IPではなく、セキュリティに関係するLabel集合から決まります。
同じLabelで再作成されたPodは同じIdentityを受け取り、同等のPolicyが適用され得ます。

questions.question:
In a standard Kubernetes deployment using Cilium CRDs, where is cluster-wide Cilium state such as identities and
endpoint metadata primarily represented?

choices.text: Only in a mandatory external etcd cluster.
In Kubernetes custom resources, with an external key-value store being optional for specific deployments.
Only in Hubble Relay's in-memory flow cache.
Only in iptables-save output on each node.

explanation.en:
Modern Cilium Kubernetes deployments commonly use CRDs as the datastore. An external kvstore can be used in
certain architectures, but it is not mandatory for a standard CRD-based deployment.
explanation.ja:
一般的なKubernetes上のCiliumではCRDが状態管理に使われます。外部KV Storeを利用する構成もありますが、
標準的なCRDベース構成で必須ではありません。

questions.question: Why can Cilium replace kube-proxy rather than merely coexist with it as a policy engine?

choices.text: It implements Kubernetes Service translation and load balancing in eBPF at socket and packet hooks.
It replaces the Kubernetes API server's EndpointSlice controller with Hubble Relay.
It asks the Cilium operator to proxy every connection through a userspace TCP listener.
It converts every ClusterIP Service into a public DNS record managed by CoreDNS.

explanation.en:
kube-proxy's central job is implementing Service virtual-IP behavior. Cilium can implement ClusterIP, NodePort,
LoadBalancer, and related service translation in eBPF, including socket-level and packet-level paths.
explanation.ja:
kube-proxyの主要な役割はServiceの仮想IPを実Backendへ変換することです。CiliumはこのService
Load BalancingをSocket HookやPacket HookのeBPFで実装できるため、kube-proxyを置き換えられます。

questions.question:
A process inside a pod connects to a ClusterIP and Cilium translates the destination before the application emits
packets into the network stack. Which mechanism most directly describes this fast path?

choices.text: BGP ECMP selection performed by the upstream router.
VXLAN decapsulation at the remote node.
Socket-level load balancing attached to cgroup socket hooks.
An Envoy HTTP filter attached to every application container.

explanation.en:
Cilium's socket load balancer can translate a Service address at socket connect/send time through cgroup socket
hooks, avoiding repeated per-packet Service lookup for that connection.
explanation.ja:
CiliumのSocket Load BalancerはcgroupのSocket Hookで、接続時などにService AddressをBackendへ
変換できます。その接続でPacketごとにService Lookupする処理を減らせます。

questions.question:
Two nodes have routable host IP addresses, but the underlay has no routes for pod CIDRs. Which Cilium routing
configuration is most likely to work without changing the underlay routes?

choices.text: Native routing with masquerading disabled and no PodCIDR routes.
Kubernetes host-scope IPAM by itself, because IPAM installs all underlay routes.
BGP disabled while expecting the Linux hosts to infer every remote PodCIDR.
Encapsulation mode using VXLAN or Geneve between the node IPs.

explanation.en:
Encapsulation carries pod packets inside node-to-node VXLAN or Geneve packets. The underlay only needs reachability
between node IPs; it does not need awareness of each pod CIDR.
explanation.ja:
Tunnel ModeではPod PacketをNode間のVXLANまたはGeneve Packetにカプセル化します。Underlayは
Node IP同士を到達可能にすればよく、各PodCIDRへの経路を知る必要がありません。

questions.question: A firewall must permit the default UDP ports for Cilium's two common tunnel protocols. Which pair is correct?

choices.text: VXLAN 8472 and Geneve 6081.
VXLAN 4244 and Geneve 4245.
VXLAN 8472 and Geneve 6091.
VXLAN 4789 and Geneve 6081.

explanation.en:
Cilium uses UDP 8472 for VXLAN and UDP 6081 for Geneve by default. Port 4244 is associated with Hubble Server,
not a tunnel.
explanation.ja:
CiliumのデフォルトではVXLANがUDP 8472、GeneveがUDP 6081です。4244はHubble Server用であり、
Tunnel Portではありません。

questions.question: You switch Cilium to native routing. Which statement describes the new responsibility of the surrounding network?

choices.text: It must expose Hubble Relay on every node to carry pod packets.
It must assign the same PodCIDR to every node so Linux routing can aggregate it.
It must terminate an Envoy sidecar for every inter-node pod connection.
It must provide routes that make remote pod CIDRs reachable without relying on the Cilium overlay.

explanation.en:
Native routing sends packets into the Linux routing subsystem without an overlay header. The network must know how
to route remote pod prefixes, through direct routes, cloud routing, BGP, or another routing mechanism.
explanation.ja:
Native RoutingではOverlay Headerを付けず、Linux Routing SubsystemへPacketを渡します。そのため
Direct Route、Cloud Route、BGPなどによりRemote PodCIDRへ到達できる必要があります。

questions.question:
All Kubernetes nodes share one Layer 2 segment, and you want Cilium to install direct routes to other nodes'
PodCIDRs automatically. Which setting is specifically intended for this topology?

choices.text: `ipam.mode=kubernetes`
`tunnelProtocol=geneve`
`hubble.relay.enabled=true`
`autoDirectNodeRoutes=true`

explanation.en:
`autoDirectNodeRoutes=true` lets Cilium install direct routes through node IPs when all nodes share a common
Layer 2 network. It does not solve arbitrary multi-hop underlay routing.
explanation.ja:
全Nodeが同じL2 Networkにいる場合、`autoDirectNodeRoutes=true`で他NodeのPodCIDRへのDirect Routeを
自動設定できます。複数Hopを含む任意のUnderlay Routingを解決する設定ではありません。

questions.question:
Cilium is configured with `ipam.mode=kubernetes`. A newly joined node has no value in `spec.podCIDR` or
`spec.podCIDRs`, and pods remain pending. What is the most likely architectural cause?

choices.text: Kubernetes has not assigned the node PodCIDR that host-scope IPAM depends on.
The Cilium operator has exhausted a CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool.
The node has not opened UDP 8472, so local IP allocation cannot start.
Hubble Relay has not assigned an identity range to the node.

explanation.en:
Kubernetes host-scope IPAM consumes the PodCIDR assigned to the Node object by Kubernetes. If the controller
manager is not allocating node CIDRs, the Cilium agent waits and cannot allocate pod IPs from that range.
explanation.ja:
Kubernetes Host Scope IPAMはKubernetesがNode Objectへ設定したPodCIDRを使います。
kube-controller-managerなどがNode CIDRを割り当てていなければ、Cilium Agentは待機しPod IPを払い出せません。

questions.question:
In the default cluster-pool IPAM mode, which sequence most accurately describes how a pod IP becomes available on
a new node?

choices.text: The Cilium operator assigns PodCIDRs in a CiliumNode, and the node agent allocates pod IPs locally.
The cloud load balancer assigns a node range, and Envoy subdivides it per endpoint.
kube-proxy allocates a PodCIDR, and Hubble Relay selects one address for each pod.
The CNI plugin chooses any unused cluster IP and stores it only in iptables.

explanation.en:
In cluster-pool IPAM, the operator allocates per-node PodCIDRs and records them in `CiliumNode.spec.ipam.podCIDRs`.
The Cilium agent then performs host-scope allocation from its node's assigned ranges.
explanation.ja:
Cluster Pool IPAMではCilium OperatorがNodeごとのPodCIDRを割り当て、
`CiliumNode.spec.ipam.podCIDRs`へ記録します。その範囲から各NodeのAgentがPod IPをローカルに払い出します。

questions.question:
Multi-pool IPAM is enabled. You need a pod to fail scheduling rather than silently use the default pool when its
requested pool name is unknown. Which annotation should be added to the pod?

choices.text: `ipam.cilium.io/require-pool-match: "true"`
`cilium.io/ipam-strict: "enabled"`
`service.cilium.io/shared: "false"`
`network.cilium.io/require-pod-cidr: "true"`

explanation.en:
`ipam.cilium.io/require-pool-match: "true"` makes a missing or unmatched requested pool an error. Pool selection
can otherwise fall back to the default pool in supported scenarios.
explanation.ja:
`ipam.cilium.io/require-pool-match: "true"`を付けると、指定Poolが存在しない、または一致しない場合に
Default PoolへFallbackせずエラーにできます。

questions.question:
A pod is deleted and recreated with the same labels. Why is the recreated object still represented by a new
Cilium endpoint even if it receives the same security identity?

choices.text: A security identity is derived from the endpoint ID, so both values must always change together.
A Cilium endpoint is a permanent namespace-level policy object rather than a workload instance.
Endpoint objects exist only for host-network pods and are unrelated to ordinary pods.
Endpoint lifecycle follows the concrete pod/network interface, while identity can be reused by equal labels.

explanation.en:
A Cilium endpoint represents a specific workload networking instance, normally one pod. Its lifecycle follows that
pod. Security identity is a separate label-derived concept and may be reused across equivalent endpoints.
explanation.ja:
Cilium Endpointは通常、特定のPod Network Instanceを表し、そのPodのLifecycleに従います。一方、
Security IdentityはLabel由来なので、別Endpointでも同じLabelなら再利用され得ます。

questions.question:
WireGuard encryption is enabled for Cilium-managed pod traffic. Which firewall rule is required between nodes for
the default Cilium WireGuard tunnel?

choices.text: Allow UDP 51871 between node addresses.
Allow UDP 6081 only from Hubble Relay.
Allow TCP 4250 between all pods.
Allow IP protocol ESP between Cilium agents.

explanation.en:
Cilium's WireGuard encryption uses UDP port 51871 by default between nodes. TCP 4250 is associated with Cilium
mutual-auth traffic, while ESP is used by IPsec.
explanation.ja:
CiliumのWireGuard暗号化では、デフォルトでNode間のUDP 51871を許可する必要があります。
TCP 4250はMutual Authentication関連、ESPはIPsecで使われます。

questions.question: A network team asks for the TCP or UDP port used by Cilium IPsec encryption. What is the most accurate response?

choices.text: IPsec uses TCP 4240 so cilium-health can authenticate encrypted packets.
IPsec primarily requires IP protocol ESP rather than a Cilium-specific TCP or UDP data port.
IPsec always uses TCP 179 because routes and encryption share the BGP session.
IPsec always uses UDP 51871, the same fixed port as WireGuard.

explanation.en:
The encrypted data plane for Cilium IPsec uses ESP, an IP protocol, rather than a fixed TCP or UDP application
port. Additional control-plane requirements depend on the environment.
explanation.ja:
Cilium IPsecの暗号化Data Planeでは、固定のTCP/UDP PortではなくIP ProtocolのESPを利用します。
環境によって追加要件はありますが、WireGuardの51871/UDPとは異なります。

questions.question:
A compliance system requires selected workloads to reach an external SaaS provider from one stable node address.
Which Cilium object expresses both the source workloads and the egress gateway selection?

choices.text: A `CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool`.
A `CiliumBGPAdvertisement`.
A `CiliumGatewayClassConfig`.
A `CiliumEgressGatewayPolicy`.

explanation.en:
`CiliumEgressGatewayPolicy` selects source endpoints and destination CIDRs, then identifies the gateway node or
egress interface through which matching outbound traffic should leave.
explanation.ja:
`CiliumEgressGatewayPolicy`は送信元Endpointと宛先CIDRを選択し、該当する外向き通信をどのGateway Node、
またはEgress Interfaceから出すかを定義します。

questions.question:
You enable Cilium's netkit device mode on a recent Linux kernel, but agent startup reports that the device type is
unavailable. Which kernel option should be checked first?

choices.text: `CONFIG_BRIDGE_NF_EBTABLES=y`
`CONFIG_NETKIT=y`
`CONFIG_NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_MASQUERADE=y`
`CONFIG_IP_VS=y`

explanation.en:
Netkit device mode requires kernel support built with `CONFIG_NETKIT=y`. Netkit is designed as a modern virtual
device option for efficient eBPF-oriented container networking.
explanation.ja:
Netkit Device ModeにはKernelの`CONFIG_NETKIT=y`が必要です。NetkitはeBPFを前提に効率的な
Container Networkingを行うための新しいVirtual Deviceです。

questions.question:
Which statement best describes the boundary between Cilium's eBPF datapath and Envoy for application-aware
networking?

choices.text: eBPF processes only DNS, while Envoy handles TCP, UDP, and ICMP in the kernel.
eBPF handles high-performance L3/L4 paths and redirects selected L7 traffic to node-local Envoy.
Envoy performs all L3 routing, while eBPF is used only to export Prometheus metrics.
Every pod must contain an Envoy sidecar before Cilium can enforce any L3/L4 policy.

explanation.en:
Cilium enforces and forwards much of L3/L4 traffic in eBPF. Features requiring application-protocol parsing, such
as HTTP policy and Gateway API, use Envoy, with eBPF transparently redirecting the selected traffic.
explanation.ja:
CiliumはL3/L4の多くをeBPFで処理します。HTTP PolicyやGateway APIなどL7解析が必要な通信は、
eBPF DatapathからNode Local Envoyへ透過的にRedirectされます。

questions.question: The Cilium operator is restarted during maintenance. Which statement about its availability is most accurate?

choices.text: The operator is a per-pod sidecar, so only pods on the same node are affected.
The operator replaces the kernel verifier, so already loaded eBPF programs become invalid.
Cluster-wide reconciliation may pause, but agents can continue enforcing already programmed datapath state.
Every packet must synchronously pass through the operator, so all data traffic stops.

explanation.en:
The operator handles cluster-wide reconciliation outside the normal packet path. Losing it can delay functions
such as IPAM or resource synchronization, but agents retain and enforce existing datapath state.
explanation.ja:
Operatorは通常のPacket Path外でクラスタ全体のReconcileを行います。停止中はIPAMやResource同期が
遅れ得ますが、Agentは既にProgramされたDatapath Stateを引き続き実行できます。

questions.question:
Cilium runs with the default policy-enforcement mode. A new ingress policy selects `app=api` pods but no egress
policy selects them. What is the resulting baseline?

choices.text: Ingress becomes default deny for the selected pods, while egress remains default allow.
Both directions remain default allow until a deny rule is added.
Both ingress and egress become default deny because any policy selects the pods.
Ingress remains default allow, while egress becomes default deny.

explanation.en:
In the default mode, selecting an endpoint with policy in one direction places that direction into default deny.
The other direction remains default allow until a policy selects it in that direction.
explanation.ja:
Default Modeでは、PolicyがEndpointを選択したDirectionだけがDefault Denyになります。この場合は
IngressだけがDefault Denyとなり、EgressはEgress Policyに選択されるまでDefault Allowです。

questions.question:
The Cilium agent is started with `--enable-policy=never`. What happens after valid CiliumNetworkPolicy and
Kubernetes NetworkPolicy objects are applied?

choices.text: Only CiliumNetworkPolicy is ignored; Kubernetes NetworkPolicy is still enforced by kube-proxy.
Only L7 rules are disabled; L3/L4 rules remain active.
Policy enforcement is disabled, so the policies do not restrict endpoint traffic.
Every endpoint is placed into default deny because `never` disables allow rules.

explanation.en:
`--enable-policy=never` disables network policy enforcement by Cilium. The policy objects can exist, but they
do not restrict traffic through the Cilium datapath.
explanation.ja:
`--enable-policy=never`ではCiliumによるNetworkPolicy Enforcementが無効になります。
Policy Objectが存在していても、Cilium Datapath上の通信制限には使われません。

questions.question: Which outcome is specific to `--enable-policy=always` compared with the default mode?

choices.text: Policy is enforced only for traffic entering through an Ingress controller.
All endpoints are placed under policy enforcement even when no policy selects them.
Only endpoints selected by a deny policy are protected.
All Cilium policies are converted into Kubernetes NetworkPolicy resources.

explanation.en:
In `always` mode, all endpoints are policy-enforced. Without explicit allow rules, traffic can therefore be denied
even for endpoints that no policy selector would have selected in the default mode.
explanation.ja:
`always` ModeではPolicy Selectorに選択されていないEndpointも含め、すべてのEndpointがPolicy Enforcement
対象になります。明示的なAllow Ruleがなければ通信が拒否され得ます。

questions.question:
A CiliumNetworkPolicy is created in namespace `payments` with `endpointSelector.matchLabels.app: api`. Which pods
can its endpoint selector select?

choices.text: Only pods on the same node as the policy controller.
Only host-network pods labeled `app=api`.
Every pod named `api` in every namespace.
Pods labeled `app=api` in the `payments` namespace.

explanation.en:
CiliumNetworkPolicy is namespace-scoped. Its `endpointSelector` selects endpoints only in the namespace where the
policy object exists.
explanation.ja:
CiliumNetworkPolicyはNamespace Scopeです。`endpointSelector`はPolicy Objectが存在するNamespace内の
Endpointだけを選択します。

questions.question:
A security baseline must select workload pods across all namespaces and also define cluster-wide egress rules.
Which resource is designed for this scope?

choices.text: CiliumLocalRedirectPolicy.
CiliumEndpoint.
CiliumGatewayClassConfig.
CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy.

explanation.en:
CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy is a non-namespaced policy resource whose selectors and rules can apply across the
cluster.
explanation.ja:
CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicyはNamespaceに属さないCluster ScopeのPolicy Resourceであり、
SelectorとRuleをクラスタ全体へ適用できます。

questions.question:
Consider this egress peer selector in a CiliumNetworkPolicy in namespace `shop`:

```yaml
toEndpoints:
  - {}
```

Which destinations does the empty selector match?

choices.text: Only the selected source endpoint itself.
All Cilium-managed endpoints in the policy's namespace.
No endpoint; an empty selector is always an explicit deny.
Every IP in the external `world` identity.

explanation.en:
An empty endpoint selector matches all endpoints within the selector's applicable scope. In a namespaced CNP
peer rule, that means Cilium-managed endpoints in the same namespace unless additional namespace selection is used.
explanation.ja:
空のEndpoint Selectorは、そのSelectorのScope内にあるすべてのEndpointへ一致します。Namespace Scopeの
CNPにあるPeer Ruleなら、通常は同一Namespace内のCilium管理Endpointが対象です。

questions.question:
What is the effect of the following CiliumNetworkPolicy rule for the selected endpoints?

```yaml
ingress:
  - {}
```

choices.text: It allows ingress from every endpoint in the same namespace.
It allows ingress only from the `host` entity.
It enables ingress policy enforcement without specifying an allowed source, producing default deny.
It disables ingress enforcement because the rule body is empty.

explanation.en:
A bare empty ingress rule does not contain a source allow selector. It is commonly used to put the selected
endpoints into ingress default-deny state. This differs from `fromEndpoints: - {}`, which matches peers.
explanation.ja:
Bareな`ingress: - {}`にはAllowする送信元Selectorがありません。そのため選択EndpointをIngressの
Default Deny状態へ入れます。`fromEndpoints: - {}`がPeerを広く一致させる点とは異なります。

questions.question:
A team must allow egress to `10.20.0.0/16` except the database subnet `10.20.50.0/24`. Which Cilium construct
expresses this directly?

choices.text: `toEntities` with an `exceptEntities` field.
`toCIDRSet` with `cidr: 10.20.0.0/16` and an `except` entry.
`toEndpoints` with a negative label selector.
`toFQDNs` with a CIDR wildcard.

explanation.en:
`toCIDRSet` supports CIDR entries with excluded sub-CIDRs through `except`. Plain `toCIDR` does not provide that
nested exclusion syntax.
explanation.ja:
`toCIDRSet`ではCIDRごとに`except`を指定し、より狭いSubnetを除外できます。単純な`toCIDR`には
このNested Exclusion構文がありません。

questions.question:
A `toFQDNs.matchName` rule allows `api.example.com`, which currently resolves to three IP addresses. What traffic
does Cilium allow after observing a valid DNS response?

choices.text: Traffic to the observed answer IPs while the DNS-derived entries remain valid, subject to any L4/L7 limits.
Traffic only through the cluster DNS Service IP, never to the returned destination IPs.
Traffic to every subdomain under `example.com` indefinitely.
Traffic only to the first A record because a security identity can contain one IP.

explanation.en:
Cilium's DNS proxy observes DNS answers and populates policy state for the returned IPs. Multiple answer IPs can be
allowed, and the entries follow DNS caching and TTL behavior rather than becoming permanent wildcard access.
explanation.ja:
CiliumのDNS ProxyはDNS Answerを観測し、返された複数IPをPolicy Stateへ反映できます。許可は永続的な
Domain Wildcardではなく、DNS CacheやTTLに従い、さらにL4/L7 Ruleの制約も受けます。

questions.question:
Pods have an egress `toFQDNs` rule for an external API, but DNS queries themselves are denied. Which policy
addition is normally required so Cilium can learn the destination addresses?

choices.text: An egress rule to the DNS resolver on port 53 with an L7 DNS rule permitting the needed queries.
A CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool containing the DNS answer addresses.
An ingress HTTP rule allowing `GET /dns` from Hubble Relay.
A `toEntities: [world]` rule on TCP port 179.

explanation.en:
FQDN policy depends on observing allowed DNS queries and responses through Cilium's DNS proxy. The workload must
be allowed to reach its DNS resolver, commonly on port 53, with an appropriate DNS L7 rule.
explanation.ja:
FQDN PolicyはCilium DNS Proxyが許可されたDNS Query/Responseを観測することで動きます。そのため通常、
DNS Resolverへの53番Portと必要なQueryを許可するL7 DNS Ruleが必要です。

questions.question:
Which egress rule structure is invalid because it combines incompatible Layer 3 destination selectors in one
rule?

choices.text: `toCIDRSet` together with `toPorts`.
`toEndpoints` together with `toPorts`.
`toFQDNs` together with `toEndpoints` in the same egress item.
`toFQDNs` together with `toPorts`.

explanation.en:
`toFQDNs` cannot be combined in the same egress rule with another L3 destination selector such as `toEndpoints`
or `toCIDR`. It can be combined with L4/L7 `toPorts` constraints.
explanation.ja:
`toFQDNs`は同じEgress Rule内で`toEndpoints`や`toCIDR`など別のL3 Destination Selectorと組み合わせ
できません。一方、L4/L7の`toPorts`とは組み合わせられます。

questions.question:
A Cilium L4 policy contains:

```yaml
ports:
  - port: "53"
```

The `protocol` field is omitted. Which protocol selection is applied?

choices.text: TCP only, because string ports default to TCP.
UDP only, because port 53 is recognized as DNS.
ANY supported transport protocol for that port unless a protocol is specified.
SCTP only, because omitted protocols use the newest supported transport.

explanation.en:
In Cilium port rules, omitting `protocol` means `ANY`; Cilium does not infer UDP from the well-known DNS port.
Specify TCP or UDP when the distinction matters.
explanation.ja:
CiliumのPort Ruleで`protocol`を省略すると`ANY`です。53番だからUDPと自動推測されるわけではないため、
必要に応じてTCPまたはUDPを明示します。

questions.question:
A Service exposes port 80 and forwards to container port 8080. A CiliumNetworkPolicy selects the backend pods and
permits ingress only to port 8080. Will traffic sent through the Service's port 80 match the policy?

choices.text: Yes, but only if the Service is annotated as a global service.
No; Cilium policies cannot select traffic arriving through a Kubernetes Service.
Yes; Cilium evaluates the policy after Service translation against the backend destination port 8080.
No; policy always evaluates only the original Service port 80.

explanation.en:
Cilium evaluates the relevant endpoint port after Kubernetes Service translation. The connection targets backend
port 8080, so an ingress rule for 8080 can allow traffic received through Service port 80.
explanation.ja:
Cilium PolicyはService Translation後のBackend側Destination Portを評価します。この例ではServiceの
80番からBackendの8080番へ変換されるため、8080番を許可するIngress Ruleに一致します。

questions.question: A port rule specifies a named port and also sets `endPort`. How does Cilium treat the range?

choices.text: It expands the named port through every integer up to `endPort`.
It converts `endPort` into an HTTP status-code matcher.
It rejects the entire policy because named ports are unsupported.
It ignores `endPort` for the named port rather than creating a numeric range.

explanation.en:
Port ranges require numeric start ports. When the starting port is named, `endPort` is ignored rather than being
used to construct a range.
explanation.ja:
Port Rangeの開始Portには数値が必要です。開始PortがNamed Portの場合、`endPort`はRange作成に使われず
無視されます。

questions.question:
What does this L7 rule permit for traffic to TCP port 80?

```yaml
rules:
  http:
    - method: GET
      path: /healthz
```

choices.text: All TCP traffic because L7 fields are informational only.
Only TLS handshakes whose SNI is `/healthz`.
Every HTTP method whose response status is 200.
HTTP requests matching method `GET` and path `/healthz`.

explanation.en:
The HTTP L7 matcher permits requests whose parsed method and path match the specified values. Other HTTP requests
on the policy-controlled tuple are denied unless another allow rule permits them.
explanation.ja:
HTTP L7 Matcherは解析したMethodとPathが指定値に一致するRequestを許可します。同じ通信Tuple上の
他のHTTP Requestは、別のAllow Ruleがなければ拒否されます。

questions.question:
One policy allows all TCP traffic from `frontend` to `backend:80` at L4. Another policy tries to allow only
`GET /public` for the same source, destination, and port. What is the effective result?

choices.text: Only non-HTTP TCP traffic is allowed; HTTP is always denied.
The L7 rule always overrides the broader L4 allow because it is more specific.
The broad L4 allow can make the L7 restriction ineffective because allow rules are additive.
Both rules are ignored because Cilium forbids overlapping policies.

explanation.en:
Allow policies are additive. If one rule already allows the complete L4 tuple without L7 restrictions, a second
narrower HTTP allow does not subtract access from that broader rule.
explanation.ja:
Allow Policyは加算的です。同じL4 Tupleを無条件に許可するRuleが既にある場合、別の狭いHTTP Ruleを
追加しても広いAllowから権限を差し引けず、L7制限が実質無効になります。

questions.question:
A Kubernetes NetworkPolicy allows traffic from namespace `web`, while a CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy explicitly
denies the same source-to-destination tuple. Which decision wins?

choices.text: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy always wins because it is the native API.
The namespaced policy wins over the cluster-wide policy.
The deny decision wins, regardless of which supported policy resource supplied the allow.
The most recently created object wins.

explanation.en:
Cilium deny rules take precedence over allow rules across supported policy resource types. Policy type, creation
order, and namespace scope do not make an overlapping allow override an explicit deny.
explanation.ja:
CiliumではDeny RuleがAllow Ruleより優先されます。Kubernetes NetworkPolicy、CNP、CCNPの種類や
作成順序によって、重複する明示DenyをAllowが上書きすることはありません。

questions.question:
Which requirement cannot be expressed as a Cilium deny rule and should instead be modeled by narrowly scoped allow
rules?

choices.text: Deny a destination CIDR from selected endpoints.
Deny only the HTTP path `/admin` while allowing other paths on the same connection.
Deny all TCP traffic from one identity to another.
Deny traffic from the `world` entity.

explanation.en:
Cilium deny policies operate at supported L3/L4 scopes and do not provide URL-specific L7 deny semantics. Model
this by allowing only the acceptable HTTP operations and letting the L7 default deny reject the rest.
explanation.ja:
CiliumのDeny Policyは主に対応するL3/L4 Scopeで動作し、特定URLだけを拒否するL7 Denyは提供しません。
許可したいHTTP OperationだけをAllowし、残りをL7 Default Denyにする設計が適切です。

questions.question: A policy uses `fromEntities: ["world"]` for ingress. Which source category does it select?

choices.text: Only the Kubernetes API server identity.
Only pods in the same namespace.
Sources outside the Cilium-managed cluster or cluster mesh.
All Cilium-managed endpoints in any connected cluster.

explanation.en:
The reserved `world` entity represents traffic from outside the Cilium-managed cluster or cluster mesh. It is
distinct from Cilium-managed workload identities.
explanation.ja:
Reserved Entityの`world`は、Ciliumが管理するClusterまたはCluster Meshの外部から来る通信を表します。
Cilium管理WorkloadのIdentityとは区別されます。

questions.question:
A CiliumNetworkPolicy in namespace `frontend` must allow pods only from namespace `payments`. Which peer label is
appropriate in `fromEndpoints.matchLabels`?

choices.text: `k8s:metadata.namespace: payments`
`cilium.io/policy.namespace: payments`
`k8s:io.kubernetes.pod.namespace: payments`
`service.cilium.io/namespace: payments`

explanation.en:
Cilium exposes the Kubernetes pod namespace as the identity label
`k8s:io.kubernetes.pod.namespace`. It can be combined with workload labels for cross-namespace selection.
explanation.ja:
CiliumはPodのNamespaceをIdentity Labelの`k8s:io.kubernetes.pod.namespace`として扱います。
Cross-NamespaceのPeer SelectionではWorkload Labelと組み合わせて利用できます。

questions.question:
You want policy to follow a Kubernetes ServiceAccount rather than mutable application labels. Which Cilium
identity label should the endpoint selector use?

choices.text: `io.cilium.k8s.policy.serviceaccount`
`cilium.io/service-account-name`
`io.cilium.k8s.policy.cluster`
`io.kubernetes.service.account.uid`

explanation.en:
Cilium exposes the ServiceAccount name through the security identity label
`io.cilium.k8s.policy.serviceaccount`, allowing policy to select workloads by their Kubernetes identity.
explanation.ja:
CiliumではServiceAccount名をSecurity Identity Label
`io.cilium.k8s.policy.serviceaccount`として利用でき、Kubernetes上のWorkload Identityに基づく選択ができます。

questions.question:
A cluster administrator wants to apply L3/L4 ingress rules to node host traffic rather than ordinary pod
endpoints. Which policy pattern is correct?

choices.text: A CCNP using `nodeSelector`, with the host firewall feature enabled.
A namespaced CNP with `endpointSelector` matching the node name.
An HTTPRoute whose `parentRefs` points to the Node object.
A CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool with `allowFirstLastIPs: No`.

explanation.en:
Host policies are expressed with a CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy containing a `nodeSelector`. The Cilium host
firewall must also be enabled for those node-selected rules to be enforced.
explanation.ja:
Host Traffic向けPolicyは`nodeSelector`を含むCiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicyで表現します。さらに
Cilium Host Firewall機能を有効にして、Nodeへ選択されたRuleをEnforceする必要があります。

questions.question:
Which requirement is a typical reason to introduce a service mesh rather than relying only on basic Kubernetes
Service connectivity?

choices.text: Assigning PodCIDRs to nodes when the controller manager is disabled.
Replacing the Kubernetes scheduler with an eBPF scheduler.
Creating container images directly from running pods.
Consistent mTLS identity, L7 traffic controls, and request-level telemetry without changing every application.

explanation.en:
A service mesh adds cross-cutting service-to-service capabilities such as workload authentication, mTLS,
application-aware routing or retries, and request-level observability independently of application code.
explanation.ja:
Service Meshは、Application Codeへ個別実装せずにWorkload Authentication、mTLS、L7 RoutingやRetry、
Request単位のObservabilityなどをService間通信へ共通提供します。

questions.question:
An application pod managed by Cilium Service Mesh shows `1/1` containers ready rather than `2/2`. Why can this be
normal?

choices.text: Hubble Relay replaces both the application and proxy containers after startup.
Cilium can use per-node Envoy instead of injecting an Envoy sidecar into every application pod.
Cilium disables L7 processing whenever a pod has only one container.
The application container includes a hidden kernel namespace that Kubernetes does not count.

explanation.en:
Cilium's service-mesh architecture can be sidecarless: eBPF transparently redirects selected traffic to Envoy
running on the node, so each workload pod does not need its own proxy container.
explanation.ja:
Cilium Service MeshはSidecarless構成を取れます。eBPFが対象TrafficをNode上のEnvoyへ透過的にRedirectするため、
各Application PodにProxy Containerを注入する必要がありません。

questions.question: An HTTP request is subject to a Cilium L7 policy. Which packet-path description is most accurate?

choices.text: kube-proxy sends the request to Hubble Relay, which returns an allow or deny verdict.
The Cilium operator synchronously proxies the request through the Kubernetes API.
The request is parsed entirely by an XDP program before the IP header is available.
The eBPF datapath redirects the selected connection to node-local Envoy for HTTP parsing and enforcement.

explanation.en:
eBPF performs efficient traffic interception and L3/L4 handling. When application-layer parsing is required, the
selected traffic is transparently redirected to Envoy, which applies the L7 configuration.
explanation.ja:
eBPFはTraffic InterceptionとL3/L4処理を行い、Application Layer解析が必要な通信をEnvoyへRedirectします。
HTTPの解析とL7 EnforcementはNode Local Envoyが担当します。

questions.question:
You enable Cilium Gateway API support in an existing cluster. Which prerequisite combination is required by the
standard Cilium setup?

choices.text: Enable only Hubble UI; Gateway API does not use Envoy.
Enable BGP Control Plane and cluster-pool IPAM.
Disable kube-proxy replacement and disable the L7 proxy.
Enable kube-proxy replacement, the L7 proxy, Gateway API support, and install the Gateway API CRDs.

explanation.en:
Cilium Gateway API depends on kube-proxy replacement and Envoy-based L7 proxying, and Kubernetes must have the
relevant Gateway API CRDs installed. The Helm value is `gatewayAPI.enabled=true`.
explanation.ja:
Cilium Gateway APIにはkube-proxy replacement、EnvoyによるL7 Proxy、`gatewayAPI.enabled=true`、
さらにGateway API CRDの導入が必要です。

questions.question:
Which manifest selects Cilium as the implementation for a standard Kubernetes Ingress?

```yaml
spec:
  ingressClassName: ?
```

choices.text: `cilium-envoy`
`hubble-relay`
`io.cilium/gateway-controller`
`cilium`

explanation.en:
Cilium's Ingress controller is selected with `spec.ingressClassName: cilium`. The legacy annotation
`kubernetes.io/ingress.class: cilium` is also supported for compatibility.
explanation.ja:
Cilium Ingress Controllerは`spec.ingressClassName: cilium`で選択します。互換性のためLegacy Annotationの
`kubernetes.io/ingress.class: cilium`もサポートされています。

questions.question:
A single Ingress should receive its own generated LoadBalancer instead of using the cluster's shared Cilium
Ingress load balancer. Which annotation is correct?

choices.text: `lbipam.cilium.io/sharing-key: "dedicated"`
`ingress.cilium.io/loadbalancer-mode: "dedicated"`
`service.cilium.io/global: "dedicated"`
`gateway.networking.k8s.io/service-mode: "dedicated"`

explanation.en:
`ingress.cilium.io/loadbalancer-mode` supports `dedicated` and `shared` and can override the Helm default on an
individual Ingress.
explanation.ja:
`ingress.cilium.io/loadbalancer-mode`には`dedicated`と`shared`があり、個別IngressでHelmのDefault設定を
Overrideできます。

questions.question:
An Ingress has TLS configured and must redirect matching HTTP requests to HTTPS regardless of the global default.
Which annotation enables that behavior?

choices.text: `service.cilium.io/secure: "true"`
`ingress.cilium.io/tls-passthrough: "enabled"`
`ingress.cilium.io/force-https: "enabled"`
`cilium.io/redirect-http: "443"`

explanation.en:
`ingress.cilium.io/force-https: "enabled"` requests enforced HTTPS redirects for hosts with TLS configuration.
TLS passthrough is a different behavior and does not mean HTTP-to-HTTPS redirection.
explanation.ja:
`ingress.cilium.io/force-https: "enabled"`はTLS設定されたHostへのHTTP RequestをHTTPSへRedirectします。
TLS Passthroughは別機能であり、HTTPからHTTPSへのRedirectを意味しません。

questions.question:
External traffic reaches a Cilium Gateway, but a default-deny policy still blocks access to the backend. Which
two logical policy legs may both need explicit allowance?

choices.text: From `cluster` to `init`, then from `init` to `all`.
From `world` to the special `ingress` identity, then from `ingress` to the backend identity.
From the backend to `health`, then from `health` to `remote-node`.
From `host` to `world`, then from `world` to `kube-apiserver`.

explanation.en:
Traffic entering Cilium Ingress or Gateway API is assigned the special `ingress` identity at Envoy. Policy may
therefore enforce both the external `world`-to-`ingress` leg and the `ingress`-to-backend leg.
explanation.ja:
Cilium Ingress/Gatewayへ入ったTrafficはEnvoyでSpecial `ingress` Identityを割り当てられます。そのため
`world`→`ingress`と`ingress`→Backendの両方をPolicyで許可する必要があります。

questions.question:
Which `GatewayClass` field identifies the Cilium Gateway API controller?

```yaml
spec:
  controllerName: ?
```

choices.text: `io.cilium/gateway-controller`
`io.kubernetes/cilium-gateway`
`gateway.cilium.io/envoy`
`cilium.io/ingress-controller`

explanation.en:
A Cilium-managed `GatewayClass` uses `spec.controllerName: io.cilium/gateway-controller`. Gateway objects then
reference a class by its Kubernetes resource name through `gatewayClassName`.
explanation.ja:
Cilium管理の`GatewayClass`では`spec.controllerName: io.cilium/gateway-controller`を指定します。
Gateway Objectは`gatewayClassName`でそのGatewayClass Resource名を参照します。

questions.question:
A cluster has GatewayClasses named `cilium` and `istio`. Which field in a `Gateway` selects the desired class, and
where are protocol and edge listening port defined?

choices.text: `gatewayClassName` selects it, while `listeners` define protocol and port.
`backendRefs` selects it, while a Service defines the Gateway listener.
`controllerName` selects it, while an HTTPRoute defines every listener.
`parentRefs` selects it, while a ReferenceGrant defines protocol and port.

explanation.en:
`Gateway.spec.gatewayClassName` selects the implementation class. `Gateway.spec.listeners` define names,
protocols such as HTTP or HTTPS, ports, hostname constraints, and route attachment rules.
explanation.ja:
`Gateway.spec.gatewayClassName`が実装Classを選択し、`Gateway.spec.listeners`がHTTP/HTTPSなどのProtocol、
Port、Hostname、Route Attachment条件を定義します。

questions.question:
In an HTTPRoute, which fields connect the route to its entry Gateway and send matched requests to Kubernetes
Services?

choices.text: `nodeSelector` and `serviceSelector`.
`endpointSelector` and `toServices`.
`parametersRef` and `certificateRefs`.
`parentRefs` and `backendRefs`.

explanation.en:
`parentRefs` attach a Route to a Gateway or another supported parent. Within a rule, `backendRefs` identify the
backend Services and ports that receive matched requests.
explanation.ja:
`parentRefs`はRouteをGatewayなどのParentへAttachし、Rule内の`backendRefs`はMatched Requestを転送する
Backend ServiceとPortを指定します。

questions.question:
An HTTPRoute sends 90% of traffic to `api-v1` and 10% to `api-v2`. Which Gateway API mechanism expresses this
split?

choices.text: Two GatewayClasses with different controller names.
Multiple `backendRefs` with relative `weight` values of 90 and 10.
Two listeners using ports 90 and 10.
Two Services sharing one LB IPAM sharing key.

explanation.en:
Gateway API traffic splitting is configured with multiple `backendRefs` and relative integer weights. The values
are proportions; they do not need to total exactly 100, though 90 and 10 is intuitive.
explanation.ja:
Gateway APIのTraffic Splitは複数の`backendRefs`へ相対的な`weight`を設定します。Weightは比率として
扱われ、90と10なら概ね90%と10%に分配されます。

questions.question:
An HTTPRoute in namespace `web` references a backend Service in namespace `payments`. The route is otherwise
correct, but `ResolvedRefs` is false. What is normally missing?

choices.text: The `service.cilium.io/global` annotation on both Services.
A ReferenceGrant in the backend namespace permitting the cross-namespace reference.
A CiliumEndpoint object manually created for the Service.
A second GatewayClass with the backend namespace as its controller name.

explanation.en:
Gateway API cross-namespace references require explicit authorization from the target namespace. A ReferenceGrant
is created in the target namespace and permits the relevant source kind and referenced kind.
explanation.ja:
Gateway APIのCross-Namespace ReferenceはTarget Namespace側の明示的な許可が必要です。Backend側Namespaceに
ReferenceGrantを作成し、Source KindとReference先Kindを許可します。

questions.question:
An HTTPS Gateway listener references a TLS Secret stored in a different namespace. Which configuration is required
in addition to `certificateRefs` on the listener?

choices.text: A ReferenceGrant in the Secret's namespace authorizing the Gateway reference.
A CiliumNetworkPolicy allowing TCP 4245 to the Secret.
A BGPAdvertisement selecting the Secret by label.
A `toFQDNs` rule matching the certificate's subject name.

explanation.en:
The listener uses `certificateRefs` for TLS termination material. A reference to a Secret in another namespace
requires a ReferenceGrant in the Secret's namespace.
explanation.ja:
ListenerはTLS Termination用Materialを`certificateRefs`で参照します。別NamespaceのSecretを参照する場合は、
Secret側NamespaceにReferenceGrantが必要です。

questions.question:
A Gateway terminates client TLS, but the platform also requires TLS from the Gateway's Envoy proxy to a backend
Service. Which Gateway API policy resource configures that backend TLS connection?

choices.text: BackendTLSPolicy.
CiliumEgressGatewayPolicy.
HTTPRouteFilterPolicy.
CiliumL2AnnouncementPolicy.

explanation.en:
`BackendTLSPolicy` configures TLS expectations for connections from the Gateway implementation to a backend,
including server identity validation and trust material as supported by Gateway API.
explanation.ja:
`BackendTLSPolicy`はGateway実装からBackendへのTLS Connectionを設定し、Server Identity Validationや
Trust MaterialなどのBackend TLS要件を表現します。

questions.question: A valid Gateway is accepted but traffic is not programmed. Which internal control flow should you inspect?

choices.text: The CNI plugin translates the Gateway to a CiliumNode and kube-proxy sends it to Envoy.
The API server compiles the Gateway directly into an XDP program without Cilium components.
The Cilium operator translates Gateway resources into Cilium Envoy configuration, which agents supply to Envoy.
Hubble Relay translates the Gateway to iptables and the scheduler sends it to CoreDNS.

explanation.en:
The operator validates Gateway API resources and translates accepted configuration into Cilium Envoy configuration
resources. Agents consume those resources and configure embedded or DaemonSet Envoy.
explanation.ja:
Cilium OperatorがGateway API ResourceをValidationし、Acceptedされた設定をCilium Envoy Configurationへ
変換します。Agentがそれを取得し、EmbeddedまたはDaemonSetのEnvoyへ設定を供給します。

questions.question:
Which HTTPRoute match demonstrates an advantage over the limited host-and-path model commonly associated with
classic Ingress?

choices.text: Choosing the eBPF verifier version through an HTTP header.
Assigning a PodCIDR based on the caller's HTTP method.
Matching path prefix, exact header, query parameter, and HTTP method in one route rule.
Selecting the Cilium agent DaemonSet by BGP community.

explanation.en:
HTTPRoute can combine structured matches for paths, headers, query parameters, methods, and hostnames, enabling
more expressive and portable L7 routing than the basic Ingress model.
explanation.ja:
HTTPRouteはPath、Header、Query Parameter、HTTP Method、HostnameなどのStructured Matchを組み合わせられ、
基本的なIngress Modelより細かなL7 Routingを表現できます。

questions.question: What distinguishes Gateway API GAMMA producer routes from a conventional north-south Gateway attachment?

choices.text: They replace every Kubernetes Service with a Cluster Mesh global Service.
They attach a Route directly to a Service to control east-west traffic for that service.
They require an external BGP router to become the Route parent.
They can be processed only by per-pod sidecars and not by Cilium's node proxy.

explanation.en:
In the GAMMA model, a producer route uses a Service as its parent, allowing the service owner to define east-west
traffic behavior without creating a north-south Gateway listener.
explanation.ja:
GAMMAのProducer RouteではServiceをParentとしてRouteをAttachし、North-South Gateway Listenerを作らずに
Service OwnerがEast-West Traffic Behaviorを定義できます。

questions.question: Which failure mode is common in sidecar-based meshes but avoided when Cilium does not inject a proxy into each pod?

choices.text: The Linux kernel can never verify an eBPF program.
A pod cannot receive a Kubernetes ServiceAccount.
The application container is ready while its local sidecar is missing, unready, or running mismatched config.
The cluster cannot use any Layer 3 network policy.

explanation.en:
Per-pod sidecars introduce an additional lifecycle and version/configuration boundary. A sidecarless node-proxy
design avoids failures caused by an absent, stale, or unready proxy alongside an otherwise healthy application.
explanation.ja:
Per-Pod SidecarではApplicationとは別のLifecycleとVersion/Configuration境界が増えます。Sidecarless構成は、
ApplicationがHealthyでもSidecarが未起動・古い・UnreadyというFailure Modeを避けられます。

questions.question:
Why can Hubble report policy verdicts and workload identities without deploying a packet-capture sidecar beside
every application?

choices.text: Hubble reads plaintext payloads from the cloud load balancer access log.
Hubble reconstructs all traffic only from Kubernetes audit logs.
Hubble receives flow events from Cilium's eBPF datapath through the Hubble Server embedded in each agent.
Hubble requires the application to send OpenTelemetry spans for every packet.

explanation.en:
Cilium's datapath already observes forwarding and policy decisions. Each agent's embedded Hubble Server exports
those flow events, including Cilium identity and verdict context, without application instrumentation.
explanation.ja:
Cilium Datapath自体がForwardingとPolicy Decisionを観測し、各Agent内のHubble ServerがFlow Eventを
Exportします。そのためApplicationへのPacket Capture Sidecarや計装がなくてもIdentityやVerdictを得られます。

questions.question:
Hubble Relay cannot connect to the Hubble Server on any worker node. Which node firewall port should be checked
first?

choices.text: TCP 179.

explanation.en:
The per-node Hubble Server listens on TCP 4244 for Relay connections. BGP uses TCP 179, WireGuard uses UDP 51871,
and VXLAN uses UDP 8472.
explanation.ja:
各NodeのHubble ServerへHubble Relayが接続する際はTCP 4244を使います。TCP 179はBGP、UDP 51871は
WireGuard、UDP 8472はVXLANです。

questions.question:
You manually port-forward the Hubble Relay Service and want the local Hubble CLI to use its default server address.
Which local port should be forwarded?

explanation.en:
The Hubble CLI's default Relay endpoint is `localhost:4245`. The Cilium CLI command
`cilium hubble port-forward` exposes Relay at `127.0.0.1:4245` by default.
explanation.ja:
Hubble CLIがDefaultで接続するRelay Addressは`localhost:4245`です。`cilium hubble port-forward`も
DefaultではRelayを`127.0.0.1:4245`へ公開します。

questions.question:
Which command creates the standard local port-forward to Hubble Relay without manually naming the Kubernetes
Service?

choices.text: `hubble observe --listen`
`cilium hubble port-forward`
`cilium status --relay`
`cilium relay expose`

explanation.en:
`cilium hubble port-forward` locates the Hubble Relay Service in the Cilium namespace and establishes the local
forwarding needed by the Hubble CLI.
explanation.ja:
`cilium hubble port-forward`はCilium Namespace内のHubble Relay Serviceを見つけ、Hubble CLIが使う
Local Port Forwardを確立します。

questions.question:
You need a continuously updating stream of new cluster-wide flows from Hubble Relay. Which command is the direct
choice?

choices.text: `hubble observe --follow`
`cilium-dbg endpoint list --watch`
`cilium config view --stream`
`kubectl get ciliumnodes --flow-events`

explanation.en:
`hubble observe --follow` keeps the flow query open and prints new matching events as they arrive. Without
`--follow`, the CLI returns a finite set from the available flow buffer.
explanation.ja:
`hubble observe --follow`はQueryを開いたままにし、新しいMatching Flowを継続表示します。`--follow`なしでは
Flow Bufferから有限件を取得して終了します。

questions.question:
Reports say `frontend/web` connections to `backend/orders` are intermittently denied. Which command is the most
focused starting point for observing new policy drops?

choices.text: `cilium config set policy-enforcement never`
`hubble observe --from-pod frontend/web --to-pod backend/orders --verdict DROPPED --follow`
`hubble observe --namespace kube-system --protocol dns`
`cilium-dbg bpf lb list --service orders --delete`

explanation.en:
Combining source, destination, verdict, and `--follow` filters isolates new dropped flows for the reported path.
The resulting events show the policy-denied verdict and related datapath context without disabling enforcement.
explanation.ja:
Source、Destination、`--verdict DROPPED`、`--follow`を組み合わせると、対象経路の新しいDropだけを
絞り込めます。Policyを無効化せずにVerdictとDatapath Contextを確認できます。

questions.question:
After an HTTP CiliumNetworkPolicy is deployed, Hubble starts showing methods, paths, and response status codes for
the selected connection. What most likely caused the additional fields?

choices.text: BGP peers began exporting HTTP communities to Hubble Relay.
The CNI plugin copied application logs into the kernel routing table.
WireGuard decrypted every application payload inside Hubble Relay.
Traffic was redirected through the L7 proxy, which generated application-layer flow records.

explanation.en:
Application-layer metadata becomes available when selected traffic is parsed by Envoy for L7 policy or traffic
management. Hubble can then report HTTP request and response fields in addition to L3/L4 flow data.
explanation.ja:
L7 PolicyなどによりTrafficがEnvoyで解析されると、HubbleはL3/L4情報に加えてHTTP Method、Path、
Response StatusなどのApplication Layer Fieldを表示できます。

questions.question: Which Hubble CLI option shows only flows that Cilium reports as encrypted by WireGuard or IPsec?

choices.text: `--tls-only`
`--verdict ENCRYPTED`
`--protocol esp`
`--encrypted`

explanation.en:
`hubble observe --encrypted` filters for encrypted flows. The complementary option
`hubble observe --unencrypted` can help detect traffic that did not use the expected encryption path.
explanation.ja:
`hubble observe --encrypted`で暗号化Flowだけを表示できます。反対に`--unencrypted`を使えば、
想定した暗号化Pathを通っていない通信の調査に役立ちます。

questions.question:
Which Hubble component presents a visual service map and flow exploration interface while querying the
cluster-wide Relay API?

choices.text: Cilium Operator.
Cilium BGP Control Plane.
Hubble UI.
Cilium CNI.

explanation.en:
Hubble UI provides graphical flow exploration and a service dependency map. It uses Hubble Relay for
cluster-wide data rather than directly reading every node's local socket from the browser.
explanation.ja:
Hubble UIはFlowのGraphical ExplorationとService Dependency Mapを提供します。Browserから各Nodeの
Local Socketを直接読むのではなく、Cluster-wideなHubble Relay APIを利用します。

questions.question:
A team needs long-term dashboards and alerts for Cilium packet drops rather than only the finite in-memory Hubble
flow history. Which integration is most appropriate?

choices.text: Increase the BGP hold timer until it covers the retention period.
Store `kubectl get pods` output in CoreDNS.
Convert every NetworkPolicy into a LoadBalancer Service.
Enable Cilium/Hubble Prometheus metrics and scrape them with Prometheus.

explanation.en:
Hubble flow buffers are useful for interactive investigation, while Prometheus metrics provide time-series
retention, aggregation, dashboards, and alerting for signals such as drops and protocol metrics.
explanation.ja:
Hubble Flow Bufferは対話的な調査に向きます。長期Retention、Aggregation、Dashboard、Alertには、
Cilium/HubbleのPrometheus Metricsを有効化してPrometheusでScrapeするのが適切です。

questions.question:
Node-to-node health checks fail even though Hubble flow collection works. Which default Cilium port is associated
with the `cilium-health` responder and should be investigated?

explanation.en:
`cilium-health` uses TCP 4240 by default for health connectivity checks. Hubble Relay's client-facing port is
4245, and Cilium mutual-auth traffic uses TCP 4250.
explanation.ja:
`cilium-health`はDefaultでTCP 4240を使います。Hubble RelayのClient向けPortは4245、
Cilium Mutual Authentication関連はTCP 4250です。

questions.question:
You are preparing a support bundle after a connectivity failure that has already stopped reproducing. Which
command is designed to collect broad Cilium and Hubble diagnostic state from the cluster?

choices.text: `cilium connectivity test --cleanup-only`
`cilium sysdump`
`hubble observe --last 1`
`cilium config set debug true`

explanation.en:
`cilium sysdump` collects a broad diagnostic bundle including Kubernetes resources, component status, logs, and
Cilium/Hubble state. Hubble observe is better for querying flow events, not assembling a support archive.
explanation.ja:
`cilium sysdump`はKubernetes Resource、Component Status、Log、Cilium/Hubble Stateなどを広く収集する
Support Bundle用Commandです。Flow EventのQueryにはHubble Observeを使います。

questions.question:
Cilium is already installed, but Hubble Relay and the Hubble UI were not enabled. Which Cilium CLI command enables
both the observability backend and UI components in one operation?

choices.text: `cilium hubble enable --ui`
`cilium config set hubble-ui true --relay=false`
`hubble observe --ui --all`
`cilium install --hubble-relay=4245`

explanation.en:
`cilium hubble enable --ui` enables Hubble, deploys Hubble Relay, and also enables the Hubble UI. The standalone
`hubble` CLI queries flows; it does not install cluster components.
explanation.ja:
`cilium hubble enable --ui`はHubbleを有効化し、Hubble RelayとHubble UIもDeploymentします。
`hubble` CLIはFlowをQueryするClientであり、Cluster ComponentのInstallationは行いません。

questions.question:
Immediately after an upgrade, you want a command to block until the Cilium deployment becomes ready rather than
returning a single point-in-time status. Which command is the best fit?

choices.text: `hubble status --all-nodes`
`cilium status --wait`
`cilium sysdump --wait`
`cilium config view --follow`

explanation.en:
`cilium status --wait` repeatedly evaluates Cilium component readiness and waits for a successful status. A plain
status command is only a snapshot, while sysdump collects diagnostics.
explanation.ja:
`cilium status --wait`はCilium ComponentのReady状態を継続確認し、成功するまで待機します。
通常のStatusはSnapshotであり、SysdumpはDiagnostic情報の収集用です。

questions.question:
After installing Cilium, which command deploys the standard test workloads and validates pod-to-pod, Service, DNS,
policy, and other supported connectivity paths?

choices.text: `cilium-health ping --deploy`
`hubble observe --test-connectivity`
`cilium connectivity test`
`cilium status --probe-all-services`

explanation.en:
`cilium connectivity test` creates a dedicated test environment and runs the Cilium connectivity suite. It covers
more than the node health probes provided by cilium-health.
explanation.ja:
`cilium connectivity test`は専用のTest Workloadを作成し、Cilium Connectivity Test Suiteを実行します。
`cilium-health`のNode Health Probeより広い通信経路を検証します。

questions.question:
A CI job runs the Cilium connectivity suite. You want a diagnostic archive to be collected automatically only when
a test fails. Which flag should be added?

choices.text: `--all-flows`
`--exit-zero-on-failure`
`--collect-sysdump-on-failure`
`--force-deploy`

explanation.en:
`--collect-sysdump-on-failure` invokes sysdump collection after a failed connectivity test. `--all-flows` changes
flow output, and `--exit-zero-on-failure` would hide the failure from CI.
explanation.ja:
`--collect-sysdump-on-failure`を付けるとConnectivity Test失敗時にSysdumpを自動収集します。
`--all-flows`はFlow出力を増やし、`--exit-zero-on-failure`はCIから失敗を隠してしまいます。

questions.question:
You need the cluster-wide Cilium configuration currently stored for the installation, including values such as
routing mode and policy enforcement. Which cluster-level CLI command should you run?

choices.text: `hubble status --config`
`cilium config view`
`cilium-dbg config get all`
`kubectl describe ciliumendpoint --all`

explanation.en:
`cilium config view` displays the Cilium installation configuration managed through the Cilium CLI and ConfigMap.
`cilium-dbg` is primarily a node-local troubleshooting client.
explanation.ja:
`cilium config view`はCilium CLIとConfigMapで管理されるInstallation Configurationを表示します。
`cilium-dbg`は主に特定Node内のTroubleshootingに使うClientです。

questions.question:
An operator wants to enable Cilium agent debug logging through the supported cluster-level configuration command.
Which command uses the correct key and value form?

choices.text: `cilium config set debug true`
`cilium config set --debug`
`cilium-dbg config set debug=enabled --cluster`
`kubectl annotate daemonset/cilium debug=true`

explanation.en:
`cilium config set` accepts a configuration key followed by its value, so `cilium config set debug true` is the
correct form. The command normally updates configuration and restarts Cilium pods.
explanation.ja:
`cilium config set`はConfiguration KeyとValueを順に受け取るため、
`cilium config set debug true`が正しい形式です。Defaultでは更新後にCilium PodをRestartします。

questions.question:
You are testing a dynamically reloadable option and intentionally do not want `cilium config set` to restart the
Cilium DaemonSet pods. Which command expresses that intent?

choices.text: `cilium config set debug true --rolling=false`
`cilium config set debug true --restart=false`
`cilium config set debug true --wait=0`
`cilium config set --no-daemonset debug true`

explanation.en:
The boolean `--restart` option defaults to true. Setting `--restart=false` updates the configuration without
requesting a Cilium pod restart; whether a value can take effect dynamically still depends on that option.
explanation.ja:
Boolean Flagの`--restart`はDefaultでTrueです。`--restart=false`を指定するとCilium PodのRestartを
要求せずに設定を更新します。ただし実際に動的反映できるかは各Optionに依存します。

questions.question:
You edit the `cilium-config` ConfigMap directly to set the agent option normally written as
`--enable-policy=always`. How should the ConfigMap data entry be written?

choices.text: `policy.enforcement: always`
`enable-policy: always`
`CILIUM_ENABLE_POLICY: always`
`--enable-policy: always`

explanation.en: Cilium ConfigMap keys use the agent option name without the leading `--`. Therefore the entry is `enable-policy: always`, not a literal command-line flag.
explanation.ja: Cilium ConfigMapではAgent Option名から先頭の`--`を外してKeyにします。そのため`enable-policy: always`と書き、Command-line Flagをそのまま記述しません。

questions.question:
You bootstrap a kube-proxy-free cluster, so Cilium cannot discover the Kubernetes API through an existing
ClusterIP Service. Which Helm settings are typically required in addition to enabling kube-proxy replacement?

choices.text: `routingMode=tunnel` plus the Hubble Relay address and port 4245
`hostFirewall.enabled=true` plus the kubelet address and port 10250
`kubeProxyReplacement=false` plus the CoreDNS ClusterIP and port 53
`kubeProxyReplacement=true` plus explicit `k8sServiceHost` and `k8sServicePort` values

explanation.en:
With no kube-proxy present during bootstrap, the API Service virtual IP may not be usable yet. Cilium therefore
needs kube-proxy replacement enabled and a directly reachable Kubernetes API host and port.
explanation.ja:
kube-proxyがないBootstrap時点ではKubernetes API ServiceのVirtual IPをまだ利用できない場合があります。
そのため`kubeProxyReplacement=true`に加え、直接到達可能な`k8sServiceHost`と`k8sServicePort`を指定します。

questions.question:
The underlay can route every PodCIDR, and you want packets forwarded without VXLAN or Geneve encapsulation. Which
Helm configuration most directly selects this design for IPv4?

choices.text: `routingMode=tunnel` with `tunnelProtocol=disabled`
`ipam.mode=kubernetes` with `hubble.relay.enabled=true`
`kubeProxyReplacement=false` with `autoDirectNodeRoutes=false`
`routingMode=native` with an appropriate `ipv4NativeRoutingCIDR`

explanation.en:
`routingMode=native` disables routine overlay encapsulation. `ipv4NativeRoutingCIDR` tells Cilium which destination
range the underlying Linux and physical network are expected to route without masquerading.
explanation.ja:
`routingMode=native`は通常のOverlay Encapsulationを使わないModeです。`ipv4NativeRoutingCIDR`は、
LinuxおよびUnderlay NetworkがSNATなしでRouteできるとCiliumがみなすIPv4範囲を示します。

questions.question:
A security appliance permits Geneve but blocks VXLAN. Which Helm value changes Cilium's tunnel protocol while
retaining encapsulation mode?

choices.text: `tunnelProtocol=geneve`
`routingMode=geneve`
`geneve.enabled=true` and `vxlan.enabled=false`
`encapsulation.protocol=udp6081`

explanation.en:
`tunnelProtocol=geneve` selects Geneve for tunnel mode. The routing mode remains tunnel; Geneve is a tunnel
protocol choice rather than a routing mode value.
explanation.ja:
Tunnel ModeのProtocolをGeneveへ変える値は`tunnelProtocol=geneve`です。
GeneveはRouting Modeそのものではなく、Tunnel Mode内で選択するEncapsulation Protocolです。

questions.question:
You plan to upgrade Cilium while retaining the Helm values from the currently installed release, except for any
values explicitly overridden on the command line. Which option provides that behavior?

choices.text: `cilium config view --apply`
`cilium upgrade --reset-values`
`cilium upgrade --reuse-values`
`cilium install --inherit-config`

explanation.en:
`cilium upgrade --reuse-values` reuses values from the latest Helm release and applies explicit overrides.
`--reset-values` instead starts from the chart's built-in values.
explanation.ja:
`cilium upgrade --reuse-values`は現在のHelm Releaseの値を再利用し、明示したOverrideを適用します。
`--reset-values`はChart組み込みのDefault値から開始するため逆の挙動です。

questions.question:
Two clusters use Cilium tunnel mode and have node connectivity, but both allocate pod addresses from
`10.20.0.0/16`. What is the most fundamental Cluster Mesh problem?

choices.text: Global Services work only when every pod has a public IP.
Tunnel mode requires both clusters to use identical PodCIDRs.
Cluster Mesh rewrites all pod addresses, so the overlap is harmless.
Their PodCIDRs overlap, so a remote pod IP cannot be routed unambiguously.

explanation.en:
Cluster Mesh requires unique, non-overlapping PodCIDRs across all connected clusters and nodes. Cilium preserves pod
addressing across the mesh rather than automatically NATing overlapping pod networks.
explanation.ja:
Cluster Meshでは接続する全Cluster・全NodeのPodCIDRが一意で重複しない必要があります。
Ciliumは重複Pod Networkを自動NATして解決する仕組みではないため、Remote Pod IPを一意にRouteできません。

questions.question:
Cluster A runs Cilium 1.20.x and Cluster B runs 1.18.x. Their networks and certificates are otherwise correct. Which
prerequisite is violated?

choices.text: The older cluster must use kube-proxy rather than Cilium service load balancing.
Cluster Mesh supports only odd-numbered minor releases.
Cilium versions may differ by no more than one minor release.
Connected clusters must run exactly the same patch release.

explanation.en:
Cilium versions in a Cluster Mesh may differ by at most one minor release. A 1.20.x-to-1.18.x connection has a
two-minor gap and is outside that supported prerequisite.
explanation.ja:
Cluster Mesh内のCilium Version差は最大1 Minor Releaseです。1.20.xと1.18.xは2 Minor離れているため、
NetworkやCertificateが正しくてもPrerequisiteを満たしません。

questions.question:
An administrator accidentally assigns `cluster.name=prod` and `cluster.id=7` to two clusters before connecting
them. Why must this be corrected?

choices.text: Cluster names may repeat, but every Service name must be globally unique.
Each cluster needs a unique human-readable name and numeric ID for mesh identity.
Cluster IDs may repeat when the clusters use different PodCIDRs.
Only the Kubernetes API server name needs to be unique.

explanation.en:
Each Cluster Mesh member must have a unique cluster name and cluster ID. The cluster ID participates in security
identity allocation, so changing it on a running cluster can require workload restarts.
explanation.ja:
Cluster Meshに参加する各Clusterには一意なCluster NameとCluster IDが必要です。
Cluster IDはSecurity Identityの生成にも関係するため、稼働中に変更するとWorkloadのRestartが必要になり得ます。

questions.question:
Three clusters use native routing. Each cluster's `ipv4NativeRoutingCIDR` covers only its own PodCIDR, even though
the underlay has routes for all three. What should be changed?

choices.text: Remove the underlay routes and let Hubble Relay advertise the PodCIDRs.
Enable VXLAN only for traffic whose source and destination are in different namespaces.
Set every cluster's Service CIDR as the native routing CIDR instead.
Set the native routing CIDR in each cluster to cover the PodCIDRs of all connected clusters.

explanation.en:
In native-routed Cluster Mesh, each cluster's native routing CIDR must encompass all PodCIDRs in the mesh. This
allows Cilium to hand those destinations to the underlay without masquerading or encapsulation.
explanation.ja:
Native RoutingのCluster Meshでは、各ClusterのNative Routing CIDRがMesh内すべてのPodCIDRを包含する必要があります。
これによりCiliumは対象通信をMasqueradeやEncapsulationせずUnderlayへ渡せます。

questions.question: A design raises `clustermesh.maxConnectedClusters` from the default 255 to 511. Which consequence is most accurate?

choices.text: It automatically renumbers existing cluster IDs without traffic disruption.
It doubles the maximum identities and can differ between clusters.
It changes Hubble Relay from TCP 4245 to TCP 511.
It reduces the cluster-local identity space and must be configured consistently across the mesh.

explanation.en:
More bits are reserved for cluster IDs when the limit is 511, leaving fewer bits for cluster-local identities.
Every cluster must use the same value, and changing it on a live installation is unsafe.
explanation.ja:
511 Clusterを扱うためCluster ID側へ多くのBitを割り当てるので、Cluster-local Identityの上限は減ります。
Mesh内で同じ値を使う必要があり、既存Clusterでの変更は通信やPolicy Enforcementを壊す恐れがあります。

questions.question:
Which command enables the Cluster Mesh control plane for kubeconfig context `cluster-a`, exposes it through a
LoadBalancer Service, and enables the local cache of remote cluster information?

choices.text: `cilium clustermesh connect --context cluster-a --service-type ClusterIP --cache-remote`
`cilium clustermesh enable --context cluster-a --service-type LoadBalancer --enable-kvstoremesh`
`hubble relay enable --context cluster-a --kvstoremesh --port 4245`
`cilium install --context cluster-a --global-service --relay-type LoadBalancer`

explanation.en:
`cilium clustermesh enable` installs/enables the Cluster Mesh control-plane components. `--service-type` controls
their exposure, and `--enable-kvstoremesh` enables the extension that caches remote information locally.
explanation.ja:
`cilium clustermesh enable`はCluster Mesh Control Plane Componentを有効化します。
`--service-type`で公開方式を選び、`--enable-kvstoremesh`でRemote Cluster情報をLocalへCacheするExtensionを有効化します。

questions.question:
Cluster Mesh is enabled separately in kubeconfig contexts `cluster-a` and `cluster-b`. Which command initiated from
cluster A connects it to cluster B using the CLI's context flags?

choices.text: `cilium clustermesh enable --context cluster-a --peer cluster-b`
`cilium clustermesh connect --context cluster-a --destination-context cluster-b`
`kubectl --context cluster-b annotate cluster cluster-a=connected`
`cilium config set cluster-a.remote-context cluster-b`

explanation.en:
The source cluster is selected with the inherited `--context` flag, while the remote target is supplied through
`--destination-context` to `cilium clustermesh connect`.
explanation.ja:
Source Clusterは共通Flagの`--context`で選択し、Remote Clusterは
`cilium clustermesh connect`の`--destination-context`で指定します。

questions.question:
After connecting two clusters, which command waits until the Cluster Mesh status for `cluster-a` becomes successful
instead of returning immediately?

choices.text: `cilium status --context cluster-a --mesh-only --follow`
`hubble status --context cluster-a --remote-nodes`
`cilium clustermesh connect --context cluster-a --wait-only`
`cilium clustermesh status --context cluster-a --wait`

explanation.en:
`cilium clustermesh status --wait` waits for successful Cluster Mesh status. `--context` selects the cluster whose
control-plane and remote-cluster connectivity are inspected.
explanation.ja:
`cilium clustermesh status --wait`はCluster Mesh Statusが成功するまで待機します。
`--context`でControl PlaneとRemote接続を確認する対象Clusterを選択します。

questions.question:
A Service named `orders` exists in namespace `shop` in both clusters. Which metadata is required for Cilium to treat
the two Services as one Global Service?

choices.text: Set `clusterIP: None` and give each Service a globally unique name.
Add `service.cilium.io/shared: "false"` to only one Service and use different namespaces.
Add `service.cilium.io/global: "true"` to the Services while keeping the same name and namespace.
Add `cilium.io/cluster-mesh: "orders.shop"` to the Deployments rather than the Services.

explanation.en:
Cilium Global Services are declared with `service.cilium.io/global: "true"` on Services that have matching names
and namespaces in the connected clusters. Their backends can then participate in cross-cluster load balancing.
explanation.ja:
Cilium Global Serviceは、接続Cluster間で同じNameとNamespaceを持つServiceへ
`service.cilium.io/global: "true"`を付けて宣言します。これによりBackendがCluster間Load Balancingへ参加します。

questions.question:
In cluster A, a Global Service has `service.cilium.io/shared: "false"`. Cluster B uses the same Global Service.
What is the precise effect of the annotation on cluster A?

choices.text: Cluster A stops importing all remote endpoints and uses only its own endpoints.
Cluster A's local backends are not exported to other clusters, while A may still consume remote backends.
The Service becomes a normal non-global Service in every cluster.
Only headless endpoints are exported, and ClusterIP endpoints are deleted.

explanation.en:
`shared: "false"` prevents that cluster's local backends from being shared outward. It does not by itself stop the
local cluster from seeing and using remote backends of the Global Service.
explanation.ja:
`shared: "false"`はそのClusterのLocal Backendを他Clusterへ共有しない設定です。
そのCluster自身がGlobal ServiceのRemote Backendを参照・利用することまでは禁止しません。

questions.question:
A Global Service should keep traffic local during normal operation but fail over to healthy remote endpoints when
every local endpoint is unavailable. Which annotation expresses this preference?

choices.text: `service.cilium.io/shared: "local-only"`
`network.cilium.io/failover: "remote"`
`service.cilium.io/topology: "same-cluster"`
`service.cilium.io/affinity: "local"`

explanation.en:
`service.cilium.io/affinity: "local"` marks healthy local backends as preferred. Remote backends remain available
as fallback when no healthy local backend is available.
explanation.ja:
`service.cilium.io/affinity: "local"`はHealthyなLocal Backendを優先します。
HealthyなLocal Backendがなくなった場合にはRemote BackendへFailoverできます。

questions.question:
A remote cluster is unreachable for hours, and stale Global Service backends continue receiving load-balancing
attempts. Which setting directly limits how long remote cluster data remains cached after disconnection?

choices.text: `service.cilium.io/shared: "false"` on every remote Service
`hubble.relay.retryTimeout` set to TCP 4245
`clustermesh.cacheTTL` set to a duration greater than zero
`maxConnectedClusters` reduced to the number of currently reachable clusters

explanation.en:
A positive `clustermesh.cacheTTL` revokes cached remote-cluster data if connectivity is not restored within the
configured duration. The default `0s` keeps cached information indefinitely.
explanation.ja:
`clustermesh.cacheTTL`を0より大きいDurationにすると、接続がその時間内に戻らない場合にRemote ClusterのCacheを破棄します。
Defaultの`0s`ではCacheが自動失効しないため、Stale Backendが残り得ます。

questions.question:
A newly compiled eBPF program contains a path that may read outside the bounds of packet data. What prevents Cilium
from loading this unsafe program into the kernel?

choices.text: The Kubernetes scheduler runs the program once in a sandbox pod.
Hubble Relay rewrites every unsafe instruction before loading.
The in-kernel eBPF verifier rejects programs it cannot prove safe.
Envoy converts the program into an iptables rule set.

explanation.en:
Before an eBPF program is accepted, the kernel verifier analyzes control flow, memory access, helper usage, and
termination properties. A program with an unproven out-of-bounds access is rejected.
explanation.ja:
eBPF ProgramをLoadする前にKernel VerifierがControl Flow、Memory Access、Helper利用、Terminationを検証します。
範囲外Accessの安全性を証明できないProgramはKernelへLoadされません。

questions.question:
Cilium needs connection-tracking and service-backend state to be shared across many packet-processing invocations.
Which eBPF primitive is designed for this purpose?

choices.text: A BPF map stored in kernel space
A VXLAN VNI encoded in every application header
A Gateway API Listener
A separate kernel module compiled for each endpoint

explanation.en:
BPF maps are kernel-resident key/value stores. They preserve state between program invocations and can be shared
among eBPF programs and accessed from privileged user space.
explanation.ja:
BPF MapはKernel SpaceにあるKey/Value Storeです。Program Invocation間でStateを保持でき、
複数のeBPF Programや権限を持つUser Space Processから共有・操作できます。

questions.question:
You want to discard a known malicious packet as early as possible, before normal Linux networking-stack processing
adds richer packet metadata. Which attachment point is most suitable?

choices.text: The Hubble Relay gRPC listener
XDP on the receiving network device
A Kubernetes ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
The HTTPRoute reconciliation loop

explanation.en:
XDP runs at the earliest practical receive point in the network driver. It is well suited to very fast filtering
and dropping, although it has less processed metadata than later hooks.
explanation.ja:
XDPはNetwork Driverの非常に早いReceive Pointで動作します。後段HookよりMetadataは少ない一方、
悪意あるPacketを通常のLinux Network Stack処理前に高速Dropする用途へ適しています。

questions.question:
Why does Cilium commonly attach endpoint policy programs to the traffic-control ingress hook on the host side of a
pod's virtual device rather than relying only on XDP?

choices.text: The tc hook has useful packet metadata and can enforce L3/L4 policy as traffic enters or leaves the endpoint.
XDP is available only for HTTP and tc is available only for DNS.
The tc hook is the only hook that can parse Kubernetes YAML inside the kernel.
The tc hook executes in Envoy and therefore requires a sidecar in every pod.

explanation.en:
The tc ingress hook runs later than XDP and exposes more networking metadata. On a pod-facing virtual device it is
